# ADR index by module and layer (generated)

Title, status and design item come from each ADR's first lines. **Declared** ADRs of a module are those ADR-0022 rule 2 names for it (links in its note in the layer table; the ADR of the note that adds the module) and those the DDL cites in the section header, the CREATE TABLE comment or the table's own leading comment of a table it owns. ADR status lines name design items, not modules, and the backlog maps design items to no module, so they cannot be read as a module declaration. Declared lists therefore miss ADRs whose tables have no DDL or no stated owner (for example ADR-0014 for the journal tables, whose DS-06 DDL states no owner). **Mentions** are a separate count: modules named at least 3 times in backticks in the ADR (tables counted for their stated owner), at most 4; a reading aid, not complete and not ownership.
